final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor introduced no genuinely new admissible evidence. The response appropriately narrows the supportable claim: aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents can support an operational launch-readiness statement, and public governance guidance can support documenting and monitoring limitations. But that narrower framing is not enough to move to compliant_with_caveats because the policy predicate at issue is not merely disclosure awareness or caveated wording; it requires a material limitation affecting a named launch use case or contractual segment to be disclosed, resolved, or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. The admissible record still shows a 2.1 percentage point miss in a segment named in three international pilot commitments, an open legal ticket on required disclosure, and no evidence of disclosure, resolution, or approved risk acceptance before certification. A caveated packet may be more accurate than an overbroad clean-certification claim, but it does not cure the unresolved compliance condition on this record.
